dataset: TensorFlow flower_photos / Open Vision Builder classification-flowers-v1

selection.rankDefinition: SHA256(UTF8(rankPrefix + U+0000 + sourceRelativePath)), ascending hexadecimal digest; sourceRelativePath breaks ties.
selection.creatorNormalization: Unicode NFKC, then casefold, then split on Unicode whitespace and join with a single ASCII space. Exact normalized equality only.
selection.splitDefinition: Accept first 12 eligible images per class in fixed class order; eligible ranks 0..5 train, 6..7 tuning reserved, 8..11 evaluation.

exclusions.reason: Teacup chandelier / decorated crockery rather than a clear natural rose subject; content-label mismatch identified before any model inference.
Visible flower is a blue-white bearded iris rather than a tulip; content-label mismatch identified before any model inference.
Scanned illustrated flower seed-catalog cover rather than a photograph of natural tulips; source-medium mismatch identified before any model inference.
Cathedral ceiling architecture with no visible natural rose flower; content-label mismatch identified before any model inference.
Scanned illustrated rose seed-catalog cover rather than a photograph of natural flowers; source-medium mismatch identified before any model inference.
Scanned illustrated rose seed-catalog page rather than a photograph of natural flowers; source-medium mismatch identified before any model inference.
Manufactured sunflower-shaped garden ornaments rather than natural sunflowers; content-label mismatch identified before any model inference.

steps: copy exact RGBA bytes to a fresh image to strip metadata
save PNG with compress_level=9 and optimize=False
canonicalTransform.colorManagement: Pillow convert(RGBA); no ICC color-management transform applied
canonicalTransform.comparisonInput: Both browser and PyTorch independently decode identical canonical PNG bytes; source JPEG hashes preserve provenance. JPEG decoding is standardized for this experiment, not qualified cross-runtime.

notes: The archived license provides creator name and Flickr source URL for every image; titles are not supplied in that attribution inventory.
Original JPEG bytes are unmodified. Canonical PNGs apply EXIF orientation, convert to RGBA, strip metadata, and encode losslessly without resizing.
Retain each image creator, source URL, license link, and this transformation notice with any redistributed input image or contact sheet.
The TensorFlow documentation page license and code license are separate from these archived photo licenses.

visualAudit.scope: All final60 contact-sheet images reviewed for obvious class-content mismatch and visible near duplicates; seven explicit image exclusions retain their reasons. Difficult composition, photographic edits, and background objects retained.
visualAudit.sourcePretrainingIndependence: Not established; held-out means unused in this additional head-training experiment.
